stories.text: As a ledger reader, I want each decision's quote to state the decision in the team's words so that the ledger holds no person's spoken words.
As a ledger reader, I want a decision's context, decision and consequences to name roles instead of people, times of day and personal machines so that the ledger holds nothing personal.
As a brief author anchoring a decision, I want its decision, context and consequences to mean exactly what was ruled so that a review against the ledger checks the same obligations as before.
As a card lead landing the change, I want the design gate to pass with the schema untouched so that the ledger stays valid under the method it is measured by.
